method: Built-in ImageGen, based on v5 SketchUp exported elevations and model change log

jobs.prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render. Authoritative input: JESB LOT20 V5 Front SketchUp orthographic elevation. Create photoreal architectural elevation faithfully preserving ALL geometry, roof silhouette and facets, window/door number and placement, proportions, material boundaries and panel joints. Front: exact updated garage roof silhouette, taller back profile behind front garage ridge. Smooth Arctic White LARGE FLAT HARDIE PANELS with sparse thin joints: garage window bay 3 equal columns, no horizontal joints; bay LEFT of stone entry 3 columns x3 rows; tall three-window bay RIGHT of entry 2 columns x3 rows. Joints stop at openings. Two BLACK smooth feature panels between upstairs/downstairs triple-window groups, each a SINGLE UNDIVIDED flat panel, no joint/no lap lines. Stone entry surround pale rectangular natural stone; rest white brick. Palette matches model: off-white fine textured brick, Arctic White flat fiber-cement panels RGB241,242,237, matte black panels RGB38,38,40, charcoal shingle hip roofs, white fascia, black frames/doors/railings. Realistic reflective glass, soft bright daylight, blue sky/wispy clouds, distant trees visible low only behind sides of building. Straight ORTHOGRAPHIC view, never perspective. Wide approx2.1:1 composition, full building large, modest sky, thin ground line at extreme image bottom. No broad foreground lawn/driveway, no blue band or blank band below grade. No added cars, people, shrubs, text, watermark. Smooth Hardie panels must NOT become horizontal lap siding. Retain original white vertical board-and-batten where shown.
